output-contract-required-sections-only: output_contract_partial checks DIFFERENT contract fields on each runtime. TS verify_output_contract_partial -> contractShadowCheck (packages/harness/src/nodes/policy-gates.ts) inspects outputContract.required_sections. Python verify_output_contract_partial -> contract_shadow_check (adapter/harness/output_contract.py) inspects required_interface_fields + interface_constraints and never looks at required_sections. Root cause: the TS OutputContract class only carries required_sections; the Python OutputContract carries required_sections AND required_interface_fields AND interface_constraints (Python also has a separate check_required_sections() that verify() does not call). Reconciling this is a maintainer decision — enrich the TS OutputContract + contractShadowCheck to match Python, or make required_sections canonical and change Python — with a knock-on effect on postExecGate, which also calls contractShadowCheck. Tracked, not a regression.
output-contract-required-interface-field: Mirror of output-contract-required-sections-only: the same TS/Python divergence in which contract field verify_output_contract_partial inspects. Here Python FAILs on the missing required_interface_field and TS PASSes (it only knows required_sections). See that entry for the root cause and the reconciliation options.
